BY virtue of  the powers vested in me by Section 20(4)(b) of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, I, A. Ibathul Rauff
Hakeem,  Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, on being satisfied that the administration of the
affairs of the University of Jaffna, Sri Lanka have been seriously dislocated and that the authorities of the said University
have failed to restore normal conditions, do by this Order, appoint Emeritus Prof. Kathirkamanathan Kandasamy to be the
Competent Authority with effect from November 07, 2019 for the purpose of exercising, performing and discharging in
lieu of the Vice-Chancellor of the University of Jaffna, Sri Lanka, any power, duty or function respectively which has been
conferred  or  imposed  on,  or  assigned  to  the  said Vice-Chancellor  under  the  said Act,  or  under  any  Order,  Ordinance,
Statute, By-Law, Regulation or Rule made thereunder.
